segments.sn47.7:1.1: “Atthi, bhikkhave, himavato pabbatarājassa duggā visamā desā, yattha neva makkaṭānaṃ cārī na manussānaṃ.
segments.sn47.7:1.2: Atthi, bhikkhave, himavato pabbatarājassa duggā visamā desā, yattha makkaṭānañhi kho cārī, na manussānaṃ.
segments.sn47.7:1.3: Atthi, bhikkhave, himavato pabbatarājassa samā bhūmibhāgā ramaṇīyā, yattha makkaṭānañceva cārī manussānañca.
segments.sn47.7:1.4: Tatra, bhikkhave, luddā makkaṭavīthīsu lepaṃ oḍḍenti makkaṭānaṃ bādhanāya.
segments.sn47.7:2.1: “Tatra, bhikkhave, ye te makkaṭā abālajātikā alolajātikā, te taṃ lepaṃ disvā ārakā parivajjanti.
segments.sn47.7:2.2: Yo pana so hoti makkaṭo bālajātiko lolajātiko, so taṃ lepaṃ upasaṅkamitvā hatthena gaṇhāti.
segments.sn47.7:2.8: ‘Ubho hatthe mocessāmi pādañcā’ti dutiyena pādena gaṇhāti.
segments.sn47.7:2.10: ‘Ubho hatthe mocessāmi pāde cā’ti tuṇḍena gaṇhāti.
segments.sn47.7:2.12: Evañhi so, bhikkhave, makkaṭo pañcoḍḍito thunaṃ seti anayaṃ āpanno byasanaṃ āpanno yathākāmakaraṇīyo luddassa.
segments.sn47.7:2.13: Tamenaṃ, bhikkhave, luddo vijjhitvā tasmiṃyeva kaṭṭhakataṅgāre [tasmiṃyeva makkaṭaṃ uddharitvā (sī. syā.)] avassajjetvā yena kāmaṃ pakkamati.
segments.sn47.7:2.14: Evaṃ so taṃ, bhikkhave, hoti yo agocare carati paravisaye.
segments.sn47.7:3.2: Agocare, bhikkhave, carataṃ paravisaye lacchati māro otāraṃ, lacchati māro ārammaṇaṃ.
segments.sn47.7:3.3: Ko ca, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno agocaro paravisayo?
segments.sn47.7:3.7: Cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā, sotaviññeyyā saddā … pe … ghānaviññeyyā gandhā … jivhāviññeyyā rasā … kāyaviññeyyā phoṭṭhabbā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā.
segments.sn47.7:4.2: Gocare, bhikkhave, carataṃ sake pettike visaye na lacchati māro otāraṃ, na lacchati māro ārammaṇaṃ.
segments.sn47.7:4.3: Ko ca, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno gocaro sako pettiko visayo?
segments.sn47.7:4.7: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ;
segments.sn47.7:4.8: vedanāsu … pe … citte … pe … dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
segments.sn47.7:4.11: Ayaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno gocaro sako pettiko visayo”ti.

lines: Lepaṃ oḍḍentīti vaṭarukkhakhīrādīhi yojetvā lepaṃ karonti, taṃ makkaṭānaṃ dhuvagamanaṭṭhānanti sallakkhetvā rukkhasākhādīsu ṭhapenti.
Pañcoḍḍitoti pañcasu ṭhānesu kājadaṇḍakaṃ pavesetvā gahetabbā kājasikkā viya oḍḍito.
